name: Sodium dodecylmonooxyethylene sulfate
description: Sodium dodecylmonooxyethylene sulfate ( CAS 15826-16-1 ), also known as sodium lauryl ether sulfate, is an anionic surfactant used across personal care and industrial cleaning formulations. It delivers effective foaming, emulsification, and soil removal at competitive use levels. In shampoos, body washes, and liquid hand soaps, it functions as the primary cleansing and lather-generating agent. Industrial and household detergent formulators rely on it for grease and soil removal in hard surface cleaners and dishwashing liquids. Textile processors use it as a scouring and wetting agent. This surfactant helps to remove oils and sizing agents from fabric prior to dyeing. In leather processing, it supports degreasing and emulsification during beam house operations for high-quality results. Supplied as a clear to slightly hazy liquid, typically at 70% active matter concentration. Standard grades align with technical and cosmetic-grade specifications for various manufacturing needs. Purity and ethoxylation degree are confirmed by certificate of analysis. Bulk supply is available in drums and IBC containers, with documentation suitable for cosmetic and industrial procurement requirements.
